scientific_integrity: Proof uses exact parity-block identities and local Taylor expansions; finite checks corroborate but do not prove all exponents. No global sharp norm is claimed. Same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Real four-sign quadratic Walsh chaos, strict local extrema only for open exponent ranges; unclassified degenerate endpoints, other extrema, global optima, higher dimension and complex coefficients.
title: Two competing local maxima and distinct bifurcation thresholds in the four-sign quadratic Walsh space
